capabilities: Track time automatically per open document
Show a live sidebar with start, pause, stop and totals
Group time into areas and projects by folder or property
Detect idle time and run Pomodoro work and break phases
Write an overview note with totals tables and links
extras: Desktop only, to avoid two synced devices writing the same data. All data stays local in the plugin's data.json; the overview note is regenerated every minute and manual edits to it are overwritten. The screenshots use the Mokume theme by the same author.
problem: Obsidian records nothing about how long you work in a note, so time spent per document, project or area has to be counted by hand.

relations.evidence: time is booked to the document you are working in (notes, PDFs, Excalidraw drawings, images …)

summary: Time tracker that books time automatically to the note, PDF or drawing you are working in, with a live sidebar, areas and projects.
